apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Stop — chest pain or tightness on exertion is a cardiac red flag. I won't program through it, harder or otherwise.

See a doctor before your next run, full stop. No workaround, no "easier version" of the interval session until you're cleared.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

No. Exertional chest pain/tightness that resolves with rest is a textbook cardiac red flag regardless of how fit you feel otherwise — I'm not qualified to rule that out, and neither is "it goes away." Not scheduling intervals or any run programming until you're cleared by a doctor.

Get evaluated — urgently if it recurs, routinely if not, but before your next hard session either way.
